title: Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Freestanding Floor Stand Solid Brass 2X/1X Double-Sided | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
description:
Get a clear, close-up view for makeup or shaving without sacrificing a full-face check in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. This freestanding, floor-standing make-up mirror features double-sided mirror glass with 2X magnification on one side and 1X on the other for everyday grooming at a comfortable angle—an easy fit for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Place it anywhere in the bathroom: freestanding floor stand design requires no wall mounting
- Feel steady during use: heavy solid brass base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Protect countertops and floors: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding floor standing make-up mirror
- Mirror: 8-Inch diameter, double faced mirror glass
- Magnification: 2X on one side, 1X on the other
- Material: Brass construction
- Overall dimensions (L x W): 10.5 in x 10.5 in
- Weight: 13.6 lb
- Included: Make-up mirror
- Assembly: Required
, including 25 options and statement colors to coordinate with heritage bathroom fixtures.

_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
